# graph-manager: skills in every agent, and every `graph-execution` runs graph-manager's engine ## What to build Make an agent in a graph-manager terminal always get **the skills and the engine of the running graph-manager**, whatever CLI it is and however it starts graph-execution. 1. **Skills in every agent's folder.** At startup, graph-manager copies the engine's bundled skills (to-spec, to-tasks, run-graph) with `syncSkills(engineDir, userSkillRoots())` (apps/graph-manager/src/server/main.ts L23-32). Today the roots are only `~/.claude/skills` (or `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/skills`) and `~/.agents/skills`. Add every catalog provider's `userSkillDirs` (`PROVIDER_CATALOG` from `graph-execution/api`, paths relative to HOME), resolved and deduplicated, keeping today's two first. Honour the overrides: - `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` → `/skills` replaces `.claude/skills`; - `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` → `/skills` replaces `.pi/agent/skills` **and** `.omp/agent/skills` (both CLIs read it); - `COPILOT_HOME` → `/skills` replaces `.copilot/skills`. - The marker and hash rules of `syncSkills` are unchanged. 2. **Engine self-delegation.** Terminals get two env vars: - `GM_ENGINE_BIN=`, which is `config.graphExecutionBin` when it is an absolute `.js` file; - `GRAPH_EXECUTION_DELEGATE=` when that file exists, else the engine cli.js. `GM_ENGINE_BIN` is currently in `STRIPPED_ENV` (terminals.ts L97). Set it **after** the strip. In the engine (`packages/graph-execution/src/launch/delegate.ts`, called first thing in `main()` in `src/cli.ts`), if all of these hold: - `GRAPH_EXECUTION_DELEGATE` is set and is an existing `.js` file; - `GRAPH_EXECUTION_DELEGATED !== "1"`; - `realpath(GM_ENGINE_BIN)` (when set) differs from `realpath(fileURLToPath(the running cli.js))` then run `spawn(process.execPath, [delegate, ...argv.slice(2)], { stdio: "inherit", env: { ...process.env, GRAPH_EXECUTION_DELEGATED: "1" } })`. Ignore SIGINT/SIGTERM while it runs (the child gets them through the terminal's process group), map a signal death to 128+n, and **return** the exit code. `main()` then calls `setExitCode(code)` and returns without parsing. Do not call `process.exit` in delegate.ts: `src/e2e.test.ts` L151-166 fails any `process.exit` / `process.exitCode` outside cli.ts's `setExitCode`. Mirror `spawnEngine` in `apps/graph-manager/src/server/shim.ts` L73-90. This catches `npx graph-execution`, a global npm install, and `node_modules/.bin/graph-execution` alike. Going through the shim keeps `--sandbox` handled by graph-manager: the shim posts it to graph-manager, and otherwise runs `GM_ENGINE_BIN`, which then sees `GRAPH_EXECUTION_DELEGATED=1` and runs in place. 3. **Windows shims.** `writeGraphExecutionShim` and `writeMcpShim` (terminals.ts L144-165) return false on win32, so Windows terminals run whatever is on the PATH. On win32 write `/graph-execution.cmd` and `/graph-manager-mcp.cmd` instead: ```bat @echo off set "GM_ENGINE_BIN=C:\…\cli.js" node "C:\…\shim.js" %* ``` For the MCP shim: `@echo off\r\nnode "" %*\r\n`. Use CRLF line endings. Add a `platform` parameter, defaulting to `process.platform`, so both forms can be tested on any OS. 4. **Engine version visible.** - At startup, when `config.graphExecutionBin` is not an absolute `.js` file (it fell back to a bare `graph-execution` on the PATH, config.ts L33-37), log: `warning: graph-execution's engine was not found next to graph-manager; terminals use "graph-execution" from the PATH (set GM_GRAPH_EXECUTION_BIN)`. - `GET /api/health` (routes/health.ts, authenticated) returns `{ ok: true, engine: { bin, version } }`, where `version` is read from `/package.json` (`engineDirOf` in sandbox-tools.ts L32-40), or `null`. **`/healthz` stays `{ ok: true }`.** - Settings shows an "Engine" card: `Engine ` and the path in mono, with test id `engine-card`. 5. **Skill text.** In `packages/graph-execution/skills/run-graph/SKILL.md`, replace the graph-manager terminal line (L40) with: `- **In a graph-manager terminal** (\`GM_INTERNAL_URL\` is set): run \`graph-execution\`. Any \`graph-execution\` there, \`npx graph-execution\` included, runs graph-manager's own engine.` Copy the updated skills to the repo's `.claude/skills/` (an identical, hand-kept copy). Delete the stray duplicates `.claude/skills/run-graph/SKILL 2.md`, `.claude/skills/to-tasks/SKILL 2.md` and `.claude/skills/to-tasks/validate-tasks 2.mjs`. Replace the stale `.agents/skills/{run-graph,to-tasks}` with copies of the current bundled skills, and delete their strays `SKILL 2.md`, `SKILL 3.md` and `validate-tasks 3.mjs`. Check the skill-text tests in `packages/graph-execution/src/install/skills.test.ts` (L100-144) still pass. ## Context: files to read before implementing - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/skills.ts` (74 lines; `userSkillRoots` L15-18) and `skills.test.ts`: L41-47 asserts the exact two roots. Update it, and add cases for the new dirs and overrides. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/main.ts` L20-37. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/config.ts` L33-56 and L93. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/terminals.ts`: - L97 `STRIPPED_ENV` - L125-138 `terminalEnv(base, binDir?, reviewersFile?)`: change it to an options object or add a 4th parameter `{ engineBin?, delegate? }`, and update the call at L182 - L144-165 the shim writers - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/app.ts` L83-96: computes `hasShim` and creates `TerminalManager({ workspacesDir, binDir, reviewersFile, extraEnv })`. Pass the engine bin and the shim path (`fileURLToPath(new URL("./shim.js", import.meta.url))`, only when it exists). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/shim.ts` (110 lines). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/terminals.test.ts`: - L68-78 `terminalEnv` tests (one says it "strips GM_PASSWORD"; also add that `GM_ENGINE_BIN` from the parent is replaced by the configured one) - L123-147 shim tests (exact text) - L266-279 `writeMcpShim` - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/health.ts` (9 lines), `auth.test.ts` (L39, L81, L148: `/api/health` needs auth), `web/pages/Settings.tsx` (L173-200; card pattern `

…

`; fetch pattern from `SandboxCard.tsx` L36-46), `web/Settings.test.tsx` (`fakeApi()`: add `/api/health`). - `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.ts`: L1-2 (`#!/usr/bin/env node`, `import "./env.js"`), `main` (L428-443), L445 `await main();`, `setExitCode` (L63-66). - `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.test.ts` L12-20: `run(args, cwd, env)` runs the built `dist/cli.js`. ## Step-by-step tasks ### CREATE `packages/graph-execution/src/launch/delegate.ts` (+ `delegate.test.ts`) - **IMPLEMENT**: `delegateTarget(env, selfCliPath): string | undefined` (pure, unit-tested) and `runDelegate(target, args): Promise`. - **UPDATE** `cli.ts` `main()`: `const target = delegateTarget(process.env, fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)); if (target) { setExitCode(await runDelegate(target, argv.slice(2))); return; }`. - **TEST** (in cli.test.ts, against the built CLI): - `GRAPH_EXECUTION_DELEGATE=/d.js` (the script prints `delegated ` + its args, and exits 7 when it sees `GRAPH_EXECUTION_DELEGATED=1`) and `GM_ENGINE_BIN=/other.js` → stdout `delegated --version`, exit 7. - With `GM_ENGINE_BIN` = the real `dist/cli.js` → it prints the real version (no delegation). - With `GRAPH_EXECUTION_DELEGATED=1` → no delegation. - With the delegate missing → no delegation. ### UPDATE graph-manager `skills.ts`, `terminals.ts`, `app.ts`, `main.ts`, `routes/health.ts`, `web/pages/Settings.tsx` (+ tests) - **TEST**: - `userSkillRoots({}, "/h")` includes `/h/.pi/agent/skills`, `/h/.omp/agent/skills`, `/h/.copilot/skills`, `/h/.qwen/skills`, `/h/.codex/skills` and `/h/.config/opencode/skills`, each once, with `/h/.claude/skills` and `/h/.agents/skills` first; plus the override cases. - `terminalEnv` sets both env vars. - The `.cmd` shim content with `platform: "win32"`. - `/api/health` returns the engine version; `/healthz` does not. - The Settings Engine card renders the version. ### UPDATE skills text and repo copies (see 5) ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/README.md` - **IMPLEMENT**: Under the terminals section: skills are synced into each agent's folder (list them); any `graph-execution` in a terminal runs graph-manager's engine; Settings shows the engine version. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] After startup with a temp HOME, each agent's user skill folder has to-spec, to-tasks and run-graph. - [ ] In a terminal, `npx graph-execution --version` (simulated by running another copy of the engine with the terminal env) prints graph-manager's engine version. - [ ] On Windows, the terminals' PATH has `graph-execution.cmd`, which runs graph-manager's shim. - [ ] `/api/health` reports the engine; Settings shows it; `/healthz` reveals nothing new. - [ ] No stray `SKILL 2.md`-style files remain under `.claude/skills` or `.agents/skills`. - [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` pass. ## Validation commands ```bash npm run build -w graph-execution npm run typecheck && npm run lint npm test -w graph-execution -- src/launch src/cli.test.ts src/install src/e2e.test.ts npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/skills.test.ts src/server/terminals.test.ts src/server/auth.test.ts src/web/Settings.test.tsx ```
